product_goal: Fully local German reactive conversation mode preserving Frankenstein's existing dynamic human-like conversation behavior without ChatGPT/OpenAI or any external inference API.
primary_objective: maximize perceived conversational quality subject to minimum achievable end-to-end interactive latency and bounded resource use
hard_invariants: local_realtime is the baseline acceptance path
OpenAI/ChatGPT and every external inference API are optional only and never an implicit fallback
one canonical Frankenstein durable state lineage
same wake/session/memory/tool/effect semantics across voice backends
offline acceptance requires outbound network disabled before session start
research candidates never become product truth without measured promotion evidence
quality parity claims require same-corpus comparison and recorded latency/resources
implementation_lanes: local dialogue model plus Frankenstein tool/state integration
full-duplex/duplex-like turn-taking, barge-in and interruption recovery
continuous quality/latency research and model tournament
